title: Country parades and playing excursions upriver with Kid Rene
summary: Farm parades up the river; New Orleans bands came for excursions, and Summers played there with Kid Rene and Chic in 1925.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Your father never mentioned any either that you know of in his time that they had them? Never had them ever mentioned it. Yeah. Because I wondered if they had them out in the country and up in the other towns like Baton Rouge ever. Well sometimes they used to have the farming parade and different parades like that. Did he ever have bands come up there from New Orleans? I know sometimes they go up even now, the Eureka went up a couple years ago. Well we used to go up there, in my time we used to go up to New Roe to play music, play excursions.
Yeah. I used to play up there with Kid René. Oh yeah. You know him?
I knew him before he died. I didn't hear him at about one time is all I ever got to hear him. Kid René, I used to go up there and play with him, Kid René.
Yeah. And Chic was the first one I played with in 1925. 25.
